# Support

## Where to ask

- Read the [documentation](../docs/README.md) first: the
  [usage guide](../docs/usage.md), the [guides](../docs/guide/props.md) and the
  [troubleshooting page](../docs/troubleshooting.md) answer most questions.
- Found a bug, want a feature or an enhancement, or spotted a documentation
  problem? Open an issue with one of the
  [issue forms](https://github.com/andryorelabs/animated-fluent-emojis/issues/new/choose).
- Search the
  [existing issues](https://github.com/andryorelabs/animated-fluent-emojis/issues)
  before opening a new one.
- Report vulnerabilities privately, following [SECURITY](SECURITY.md). Never use
  a public issue for them.
